transcript:
Dear Dr. Patel,

Re: Mr. Whitfield

Thank you for referring this patient for review of persistently raised blood pressure. Echocardiogram shows mild left ventricular hypertrophy, likely secondary to longstanding hypertension. No other structural abnormality.

As blood pressure remains above target (148/92 at last check), I have increased Ramipril from 2.5mg to 5mg once daily. Please recheck renal function and potassium in 4-6 weeks given the CKD history, as ACE inhibitor dose increases can affect both.

I will write again once we have reviewed the repeat echo in due course.

Dr. Osei
